name: Default
shortDescription: End-to-end encrypted notes with the official web app, sync and files server, MySQL, Redis and a LocalStack queue on one domain.

alerts.message: This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
Anyone who can reach the domain can register an account. Create your own accounts first, then set AUTH_SERVER_DISABLE_USER_REGISTRATION to true and redeploy.

Premium server features such as two-factor authentication and file uploads need a subscription record inserted into the database for each account with the SQL commands from the upstream guide, run in the standard-notes-db service.
